mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and nephrotoxicity that may impair clindamycin clearance and increase risk of adverse effects; both agents can cause diarrhea and C. difficile colitis.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and signs of diarrhea; ensure adequate hydration with foscarnet; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; discontinue clindamycin if diarrhea develops.
